title_o: Detecting the snake in the grass: attention to fear-relevant stimuli by adults and young children.
verdict_reason: The analysis-ready .sav (guid nd7we) has 48 rows with average, parentvschild and Stim_cond; the type-3 2x2 between ANOVA run in base R gives the Stim_cond main effect F(1,44)=1.437, p=.2371, eta^2=.032, exactly the table and the report. Caution: the audit script's extracted statistic ([[4]]) is the age x stimulus interaction (F=1.589, p=.214, .035), not the key effect the table carries.

data_files.path: Data/LoBue & DeLoache Replication Final File Ready for Analysis.sav
data_files.notes: one row per participant; cells children/snakes 12, children/caterpillars 13, parent/snakes 11, parent/caterpillars 12; average has no NA
raw data before screening; not opened

key_test.test: aov average ~ parentvschild * Stim_cond with sum contrasts, type-3 via drop1; key effect per table and report = Stim_cond main effect (script extracts the interaction row instead)

recompute.method: ran the audit script's model in base R (foreign, aov, drop1) on the downloaded file

obstacles: audit script extracts the interaction term (row 4) while the table and the replication report carry the stimulus main effect; a reproducer must be told which term
screening from the raw .xls to the analysis file is described in a PDF, not scripted
